derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and a derivative of G3691 (ὀξύς);
def: to sharpen alongside, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate

occurrences.text: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.
